title: On noble version of add-apt-repository, -ss command should add missing
description:
On noble version of add-apt-repository, -ss command should add missing
    deb-src for the sources but it was doing nothing, with addition of
    deb822=True in __init__ it is able to add deb-src properly.
diff:
diff --git a/add-apt-repository b/add-apt-repository
index 8dc338f..9e60ed0 100755
--- a/add-apt-repository
+++ b/add-apt-repository
@@ -19,7 +19,7 @@ from softwareproperties.uri import URIShortcutHandler
 from softwareproperties.sourceutils import *
 
 
-from aptsources.sourceslist import SourcesList, SourceEntry
+from aptsources.sourceslist import SourcesList, SourceEntry, Deb822SourceEntry
 from aptsources.distro import get_distro
 from copy import copy
 from gettext import gettext as _
@@ -34,7 +34,7 @@ class AddAptRepository(object):
     def __init__(self):
         gettext.textdomain("software-properties")
         self.distro = get_distro()
-        self.sourceslist = SourcesList()
+        self.sourceslist = SourcesList(deb822=True)
         self.distro.get_sources(self.sourceslist)
 
     def parse_args(self, args):
@@ -299,7 +299,7 @@ class AddAptRepository(object):
                 continue
 
             s = replace_source_entry(b, type=self.source_type)
-            s_entry = get_source_entry_from_list(self.sourceslist, s)
+            s_entry = get_source_entry_from_list([e for e in self.sourceslist if not e.invalid], s)
 
             scomps = set(s_entry.comps if s_entry else [])
             missing_comps = list(set(b.comps) - scomps)
@@ -308,14 +308,20 @@ class AddAptRepository(object):
             s.comps = missing_comps
             if self.options.enable_source > 1:
                 # with multiple -s, add new deb-src entries if needed for all deb entries
-                self.sourceslist.add(
-                    type=s.type,
-                    uri=s.uri,
-                    dist=s.dist,
-                    orig_comps=s.comps,
-                    file=s.file,
-                )
-                print(_("Added: %s") % str(s).strip())
+                if isinstance(b, Deb822SourceEntry):
+                    # For DEB822, add deb-src to existing entry's types to preserve Signed-By
+                    if self.source_type not in b.types:
+                        b.types = b.types + [self.source_type]
+                        print(_("Added %s to: %s") % (self.source_type, b.file))
+                else:
+                    self.sourceslist.add(
+                        type=s.type,
+                        uri=s.uri,
+                        dist=s.dist,
+                        orig_comps=s.comps,
+                        file=s.file,
+                    )
+                    print(_("Added: %s") % str(s).strip())
             else:
                 # if only one -s used, don't add missing deb-src, just notify
                 print(_("Warning, missing deb-src for: %s") % str(s).strip())
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 4fd4d0f..fcaa408 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,18 @@
+software-properties (0.99.49.5) noble; urgency=medium
+
+  * add-apt-repository: fix -ss not working properly (LP: #2093420)
+    - On noble version of add-apt-repository, -ss command should add missing
+      deb-src for the sources but it was doing nothing, with addition of
+      deb822=True in __init__ it is able to add deb-src properly.
+    - Added guard for possible co-existence of traditional sources.list and
+      deb822 format, since in noble co-existence is still possible.
+    - For DEB822 format entries, add deb-src to existing entry's Types field
+      instead of creating a separate entry. This preserves the Signed-By
+      attribute and prevents apt "Conflicting values set for option Signed-By"
+      errors during apt update.
+
+ -- Talha Can Havadar <talha.can.havadar@canonical.com>  Fri, 13 Feb 2026 12:21:42 +0100
+
 software-properties (0.99.49.4) noble; urgency=medium
 
   * cloudarchive.py: Enable support for the Gazpacho Ubuntu Cloud Archive on 24.04
